annotation.bound_parties_text: A person operating an autonomous or fully autonomous vehicle under a pilot program must submit a program with required statements, and the State Highway Commission must adopt implementing rules.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The commission shall adopt rules necessary for the implementation of this section.
annotation.dates_quote: shall become effective on: (1) The date of its approval by the Governor; APPROVED: 3/14/19
annotation.robot_provision_quote: AN ACT TO AUTHORIZE THE OPERATION OF AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES OR FULLY AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES ON THE STREETS AND HIGHWAYS OF THIS STATE
